passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Say O People of Book come to common word between us and you: worship none but Allah associate nothing with Him take not one another as lords besides Allah; if turn away say bear witness we are Muslims; O People of Book why argue about Ibrahim while Torah Gospel not revealed until after him; will you not reason; you argue about what you have knowledge but why argue about what you have no knowledge; Allah knows you do not know; Ibrahim was neither Jew nor Christian but hanif Muslim not of polytheists; most worthy of Ibrahim are those who followed him and this prophet and those who believed; Allah is ally of believers; faction of People of Book wish to mislead you but only mislead themselves and do not perceive; O People of Book why disbelieve in Allah's signs while you witness

arabicExcerpts.text: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ تَعَالَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٖ سَوَآءِۭ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ أَلَّا نَعۡبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُنَا بَعۡضًا أَرۡبَابٗا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُولُواْ ٱشۡهَدُواْ بِأَنَّا مُسۡلِمُونَ
يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةُ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
هَـٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَٰجَجۡتُمۡ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيۡسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
مَا كَانَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيّٗا وَلَا نَصۡرَانِيّٗا وَلَٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفٗا مُّسۡلِمٗا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
إِنَّ أَوۡلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَٰذَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَوۡ يُضِلُّونَكُمۡ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Universal interfaith invitation (kalimah sawa'): worship Allah alone, reject shirk, refuse human lordship; fallback testimony of Islam if rejected; refutation of Ahl al-Kitab claims on Ibrahim: Torah and Gospel postdate him; appeal to reason; critique of arguing without knowledge; divine knowledge contrasted with human ignorance; Ibrahim's true identity: hanif Muslim, neither Jew nor Christian, not mushrik; true heirs of Ibrahim: followers, this Prophet, and believers; Allah as waliyy al-mu'minin; warning about faction wishing to mislead believers but only harming themselves; challenge: why disbelieve in Allah's signs while witnessing their truth

subordinateSubjects.label: Kalimah sawa': equitable common word proposal

True heirs of Ibrahim: followers, Prophet, believers
Challenge: disbelieving in signs while witnessing

notes: Pass A Imran passage 8/8. Kalimat sawa' (3:64) is foundational interfaith dialogue text. Millat Ibrahim defined independently of Judaism/Christianity. Epistemological boundary (knowledge vs ignorance) connects to muhkamat/mutashabihat framework.
